limitations: S&P 500 membership comes from a community-maintained point-in-time dataset; Nasdaq-100 membership is reconstructed backwards from Wikipedia change records; Russell 1000 is rebuilt by ranking SEC cover-page shares x price each May (no banding, float or country rules; 2016-2017 ranks use the August 2017 ticker map). Value inputs use only SEC 10-K/10-Q facts filed by the signal date; foreign filers have no value inputs. Prices are Alpaca SIP daily bars adjusted for splits and dividends; delisted holdings are valued at their last traded close. Equal-weight quintiles, next-open entry and exit, flat 0.05% one-way cost. Physics momentum variants (drift, impulse, smooth, mass, friction) were fixed before this run and are reported together; no variant was added or tuned after seeing results.
